PP-OCRv6 Small / RapidOCR

PP-OCR models: PaddlePaddle / PaddleOCR contributors.
https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
ONNX distribution: RapidAI / RapidOCR v3.10.0.
https://www.modelscope.cn/models/RapidAI/RapidOCR/files?Revision=v3.10.0
The application bundles the Small detector and recognizer, using ONNX Runtime.
See LICENSE.PaddleOCR and LICENSE.RapidOCR for Apache License 2.0 and attribution.

Manga text detector: Kellenok / PP-OCRv6_manga v0.2.
https://huggingface.co/Kellenok/PP-OCRv6_manga/tree/62375557b5b0a4b2bc8e05484a97c7ea1df7229e
The upstream model card declares Apache-2.0. Only manga_det_v0.2.onnx is bundled;
the manga recognizer and example images are not included.

All three model files are used without weight modifications. Their exact sizes
and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in model.json. Model inference, region selection
and reading order are implemented locally by Thru3D.
